source_coverage.note: Accepted files are reviewed, stored in this batch and available in the gallery.
research_notes: Normal direct source-page requests failed with a network tunnel 403; the process follow-up reported that network approval was cancelled before a decision was returned. The route was not retried. The permitted web retrieval tool supplied page text and image URLs, but no downloadable image bytes or local image artifact.

Readable article text describes shutoff valves and three types of autofill. The permitted text extraction did not expose the article photographs or their asset URLs; only comment avatars appeared as image links. Comment avatars and unrelated image-search results were excluded from collection.

The later ordinary browser page loaded normally and exposed 20 linked article image placements with 19 unique original links. All 19 original files were downloaded and visually reviewed; the repeated SideFillExample_001.jpg placement uses canonical wine-country-06. Six accepted, six held for annotations/composite uncertainty, seven excluded for branding, promotional graphics or visible/reflected body parts.

Three article still-image URLs were resolved. The embedded instructional video and any associated posters were not selected. Web image opens returned text-only ImageDisplayed placeholders, not image bytes or image-content blocks.

The ordinary browser loaded this article normally. Its three original CDN assets were downloaded through documented downloadMedia and copied from the exact returned paths.
